text: MV distribution: the 10.5 kV switchboard has two sections A and B with bus tie (00BBA10 / 00BBA20), each section fed from one UAT. In normal operation the bus tie is open and each section carries its own loads (1 x 100 % of duplicated equipment on each section, e.g. BFP A on section A, BFP B on section B). The bus tie closes automatically on loss of one incomer.
